method.scope: Local synthetic repository, warm Git objects, built-in renderer, no external pager, 160 x 48 terminal. Terminal delivery before tcell timestamps and physical presentation are outside the probe.

method.interpretation: First paint can show preserved content during a same-diff refresh. Settled includes the reload. Small differences among submillisecond focus operations are noise.
